verdict.rationale: MI355X is a hardware accelerator, not a standalone application, but its ROCm/Instinct software stack does support headless, CI-friendly automation via container toolkit, GPU operator for Kubernetes, AMD SMI, cluster validation suite, and the Spur scheduler (Slurm-compatible) — all consistent with running workloads unattended in automated pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, no headless-mode documentation, and no independent evidence of actual CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless-mode confirmation, independent hands-on reports of automated/scripted runs.
